decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche application of the firm's core luminaire know-how, but it only gets a website mention rather than its own page, which suggests weaker commitment and limited feedback from a small defence customer base, so it is the most at risk of being dropped.
The medical examination light builds directly on the firm's optical and LED expertise, and its dedicated page signals active investment and the ability to learn from clinical users.

Explosion-proof luminaires draw on accumulated certification and lighting engineering knowledge that the firm can readily assimilate, and its prominent presentation points to a stable industrial market.
The designer task light is a relaunch of an already popular product, so it rests heavily on existing knowledge and market feedback, which makes improving and keeping it straightforward.
